alloy.preparation: Pure Ni. Raw Ni, Co, Fe and Cr, as applicable, of 99.95 wt% purity. Electric-arc furnace with electromagnetic stirring for five cycles, solidified on water-cooled copper hearth. Ingots 60 mm long × 10 mm diameter, cut into 2 mm thick × 10 mm diameter pieces. Mechanically ground sequentially with 240#, 800# and 1500# SiC, ultrasonically cleaned with ultrapure water, then cold mounted in flat specimen-holder kit exposing 0.5 cm².
alloy.microstructure: Single solid-solution phase in the as-cast condition; FCC study series.

test_solution.preparation: Aqueous test solutions described as having the same chloride-ion concentration but different pH. No numerical pH or gas conditioning is supplied.

test_method.procedure_description: Three-electrode cell, specimen working and 2 × 2 cm Pt-plate counter; working-to-counter distance 20 mm, working-to-reference and reference-to-counter distances 24 mm. Saturated calomel reference in saturated KCl; cyclic scan from reported −0.8 V versus OCP to 1.4 V RE, reversing and returning to the start. PARSTAT 4000. Before each measurement, immersed and OCP recorded for more than 30 min until fluctuation below 2 mV in 10 min. At least three measurements. Tests at unquantified room temperature; no numerical temperature is imposed.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Eb associated with new-pit formation above breakdown; Eprot is the crossing of forward/reverse curves and remains distinct. Paper also calls the region above Eb transpassive, and says general corrosion predominates for Cr-containing alloys with few pits seen at high magnification.

experiments.result_note: Breakdown Eb is related to new-pit formation in the adjacent discussion. The paper also uses transpassive terminology beyond Eb; Cr-bearing specimens show only a few pits at high magnification, while general corrosion is described as predominant. The text restates the present Ni result as 0.345 V NHE; that source-supplied reading is retained without performing a reference conversion. Nominal equiatomic identity is retained in preparation. Only explicitly quantified overall chemistry is stored numerically: Cr 33.3 at.% for NiCoCr or 25 at.% for NiCoCrFe. Raw-metal purity and post-corrosion matrix/pit EDS or surface XPS are not bulk alloy analyses; no equal fractions are calculated for other constituents.
